notes_en: New setting 'Print only after payment': accepted orders wait until you press Paid cash / Paid UPI, then print by themselves. Page counts are checked first so the customer sees the exact amount.
notes_hi: नई सेटिंग 'Print only after payment': ऑर्डर तभी छपेगा जब आप Paid cash / Paid UPI दबाएँगे। ग्राहक को पहले सही रकम दिखती है।
